# streamtime_observability_provider (Resource)

A monitoring service Streamtime sends metrics and logs to: Datadog, Grafana Cloud or New Relic.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "streamtime_observability_provider" "datadog" {
  identifier = "datadog"
  vendor     = "datadog"

  configuration = jsonencode({
    api_key = var.datadog_api_key
    site    = "datadoghq.com"
  })
}

variable "datadog_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration` (String, Sensitive) The service's settings, including its keys, set with jsonencode({...}). The settings depend on the vendor.
- `identifier` (String) A short name for the provider, up to 24 lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. Changing it creates a new provider.
- `vendor` (String) The monitoring service: datadog, grafana_cloud or newrelic. Changing it creates a new provider.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the observability provider. Use it to import an existing one.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the provider's identifier. Streamtime hides keys, so set them in your configuration.
terraform import streamtime_observability_provider.datadog datadog
```
